senses.gloss: m. pl. (Chaldaism; רוּק II, with anorg. נ; cmp. רוֹקֵן) the contents of a pot upturned and emptied on a flat vessel to cool off.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 2:5">Kel. II, 5</cite> <he>מפני שהיא הופכת עליו את הר׳</he> (Var. in R. S. <he>הרומקי</he>, read: <he>הרוקמי</he>, v. infra) because she (the cook) inverts the contents of the pot on it (the lid); <cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 2:5">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. II, 5</cite> <he>הרוּקְמֵי</he> (cmp. <cite ref="T00700"><he>רֵיקָם</he></cite>).
